title: Work tape read configurations
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a list of all assignments of a possibly blank Boolean symbol to each of $k$ work tape heads. For $k=0$ this list consists of the unique empty assignment; for $k+1$, it is formed by choosing the first head’s value from blank, false, or true and adjoining each assignment for the remaining $k$ heads.
